jobs.title: Sr. Technical Implementations Specialist (US)
jobs.description:
About Measured
Measured is the pioneer and leader of incrementality\-based media measurement and optimization. Since 2017, leading brands have used our AI\-powered, all\-in\-one platform to manage, test, plan, and optimize over $35 billion in full\-funnel media investments. Measured's unique combination of automated experimentation, media mix modeling, and industry\-leading expertise helps marketers prove the incremental impact of their advertising and maximize ROI with unmatched ease, accuracy, and efficiency.


The Role


This position reports to a Director, Technical Implementations, on the team that takes every new Measured client from signed contract to a fully connected, fully loaded, and QA'd data foundation — owning the entire onboarding journey from source connections through historical ingestion, normalization, and output QA. As a Senior Implementation Specialist, you will own discrete workstreams within our largest enterprise engagements and own lower\-complexity client onboardings end to end. You will engage directly with client marketing and data teams to translate Measured's requirements into terms each side can act on, then owning the work through to a validated result. Just as importantly, you will act as a consultant to clients on preparing their data to meet Measured's model requirements — representing in detail how our product and models actually consume data, and using that expertise to judge where a requirement is firm because the model breaks without it, and where a practical tradeoff costs little. Knowing that difference, explaining it, and standing behind the call is central to this role.


This role suits a seasoned, genuinely client\-facing implementation professional with a strong grounding in marketing and media data — someone who leads client working sessions with confidence today and is on a path toward owning full enterprise onboardings start to finish tomorrow, with a Director remaining accountable for the overall program as you build toward that.


At Measured, we equip every team member with best\-in\-class technology to fuel extraordinary outcomes. We expect our team to continuously evolve alongside these tools, using AI as a partner for momentum and innovation — raising the bar on everything we build. Our people own the final voice, judgment, and accountability behind every deliverable.

 **Requirements**  

Key Responsibilities


Onboarding Delivery \& Workstream Ownership* Own named workstreams within enterprise onboardings (source connections, historical ingestion, normalization specs, QA) under a Director, or own end\-to\-end onboarding for lower\-complexity clients from kickoff through dashboard\-ready output
* Build and maintain a shared delivery plan for your workstreams — dependencies, owners, dates, blockers — and drive them to committed go\-live dates while running several concurrent onboardings without dropping threads
* Surface scope, data\-quality, and timeline risk early, with a recommendation attached rather than just a flag


Data Requirements Consultancy \& Model Readiness* Act as the client's consultant on preparing data to meet Measured's model requirements — advising on structure, granularity, historical depth, and field\-level detail so gaps are designed out rather than discovered at QA
* Distinguish firm requirements from acceptable tradeoffs, make and defend those calls in the moment with a clear account of what's gained and given up, and push back on requests that would compromise model integrity by offering a workable alternative
* Judge whether a client data limitation is a genuine blocker or manageable caveat and set expectations before go\-live; escalate precedent\-setting tradeoffs to your Director with a recommendation


Data Source Connection \& Historical Ingestion* Scope each client's required feeds (media/vendor cost, transaction/source\-of\-truth, organic, custom), determine the right ingestion method, and stand up connections across APIs, file\-based feeds, warehouse shares, and direct integrations
* Land the full history each feed requires — not just go\-forward — and prove completeness against the client's own reporting
* Diagnose ingestion failures (auth, schema drift, partial files, delivery gaps, silent upstream changes), partner with client\-side engineers and vendors to resolve them, and establish monitoring so feeds stay healthy post\-go\-live


Data Normalization \& Specification* Author and maintain the specification layers mapping raw client data into Measured's normalized model, translating inconsistent naming and taxonomy into structured, rules\-driven mappings
* Assess every spec change for downstream impact before it goes live, and balance client\-specific accuracy against patterns reusable across the book of business
* Document mapping logic and the reasoning behind judgment calls so the next person can maintain it


QA \& Output Validation* Own QA for your workstreams — the data isn't done until it ties out against client source\-of\-truth, vendor exports, and upstream feed tables
* Validate outputs against client reporting and vendor exports (e.g. Meta, Google Ads, DV360\) — using SQL and dashboards as tools — to catch anomalies, quantify variance, and isolate root cause
* Define and document acceptance criteria, and sign off with a written statement of coverage, known gaps, and caveats


Client Partnership \& Communication* Serve as a credible, trusted technical presence for client stakeholders across marketing, analytics, and data engineering, representing Measured with polish in front of enterprise stakeholders, including in difficult conversations
* Independently lead client\-facing working sessions (discovery, spec reviews, QA walkthroughs, go\-live readiness), translating technical requirements into terms marketers can act on and vice versa
* Manage client expectations on timelines and dependencies with transparency, and gather/synthesize client feedback to inform product and onboarding improvements


Subject Matter Expertise \& Technical Depth* Develop deep expertise in Measured's data pipelines, normalization layers, and platform architecture, and become the go\-to expert on specific feed types, vendor integrations, or client verticals
* Understand incrementality testing and media mix modeling well enough to know why the data has to be shaped the way it is, maintaining a working command of what each Measured product requires from the data — and the reasoning behind it — so client guidance is grounded in the model rather than convention
* Stay current on product roadmap and platform changes that affect how client data must be prepared, partnering with Product and Engineering to translate technical architecture into client\-facing guidance
* Serve as the internal reference point when data\-requirements questions arrive from Sales, Solutions, and Customer Success
* Contribute to technical documentation, implementation runbooks, and internal training materials, and represent the implementation perspective in cross\-functional initiatives and product development discussions


Knowledge Management, Documentation \& Peer Enablement* Create and maintain implementation runbooks, spec\-writing standards, onboarding playbooks, and process documentation
* Document recurring data issues with root cause analysis and prevention strategies
* Share hard\-won client and feed knowledge so no onboarding depends on one person's memory
* Serve as a second pair of eyes for peers on complex specs and QA logic
* Ensure documentation stays current with product and pipeline changes
* Model excellence in client communication, technical depth, and operational discipline


Process Improvement \& Repeatability* Streamline onboarding by automating manual, repeated, or error\-prone steps, and build reusable templates, spec patterns, and validation queries that shorten time\-to\-value for future clients.
* Improve quality and scalability by catching requirements gaps at discovery rather than QA, surfacing cross\-client issues as product/pipeline asks, and partnering with your Director and VP, Technical Implementations, on strategic initiatives like data health monitoring, proactive alerting, QA frameworks, and applying agentic AI approaches across operations.


Cross\-Functional Collaboration* Partner with Customer Success on onboarding status, launch readiness, and client health; support Sales and Solutions during technical scoping and pre\-sales data\-feasibility discussions
* Work with Engineering and Data Science on pipeline changes, ingestion defects, and model\-readiness of client data, and with Product to communicate client pain points, feature requests, and usability feedback
* File and shepherd well\-specified internal requests — with sample rows and expected behavior — so downstream teams can act without a follow\-up round, and contribute to cross\-functional projects that improve onboarding experience and platform reliability


Ideal Experience


Required Experience* 5\+ years of experience in technical implementation, data onboarding, solutions consulting, or technical account management in B2B SaaS, ideally with enterprise clients
* 3\+ years in a directly client\-facing role owning technical delivery with external stakeholders
* Extensive client\-facing experience \- comfortable leading working sessions, spec reviews, and candid timeline conversations with enterprise stakeholders, and equally comfortable doing the hands\-on data work yourself
* Consultative judgment with data requirements \- demonstrated experience advising clients on how to prepare data for a specific analytical or modeling purpose, including telling a client no and putting a workable alternative in front of them
* Extensive experience with marketing technology platforms including advertising platforms (e.g. Facebook, Google, TikTok) and analytics tools (e.g. GA4, Adobe Analytics)
* Working with data platforms, SQL, and integrations — enough to validate outputs and troubleshoot with engineering partners
* Proven ability to diagnose and resolve complex data issues including data pipeline problems, integration errors, schema mismatches, and incomplete historical loads
* Experience owning delivery of complex, multi\-stakeholder projects against committed timelines
* Experience guiding peers or client teams through technical processes they don't own
* Working proficiency with project and issue tracking (Jira, Asana, or similar) to run multi\-workstream delivery
* Track record of driving process improvements that measurably improve team efficiency or delivery speed
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with ability to explain technical concepts to diverse audiences
* Client\-first mindset with proven ability to build trusted relationships with technical and non\-technical stakeholders alike
* BA/BS preferred; background in technical field, data analytics, or related discipline


Technical Skills* Solid grounding in marketing analytics concepts including attribution, incrementality, and media mix modeling, plus hands\-on experience with paid media platforms, campaign reporting, and budget/spend reconciliation; familiarity with data visualization tools (Tableau, Looker, Mode) a plus
* Familiarity with using SQL to spot\-check data and validate reporting outputs
* General familiarity with ETL/ELT pipelines, data warehouses, and integration patterns; hands\-on experience with a specific cloud platform (Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks, Redshift, or similar) is a plus
* Familiarity with APIs and file\-based data delivery (e.g., S3, SFTP) — enough to follow and contribute to a troubleshooting conversation with engineering partners
* Practical understanding of data mapping and normalization concepts — recognizing inconsistent client taxonomies and translating them into clear, structured requirements for engineering — and experience reconciling reported numbers to a client's own source of truth
* Understanding of data privacy regulations (GDPR, CCPA) and comfort running several onboardings or workstreams concurrently, each at a different phase


Ownership \& Influence Skills* Proven ability to drive delivery through people you don't manage \- client teams, vendors, and internal partners
* Strong facilitation instincts \- keeps a working session on track and ends it with decisions and owners
* Knowledge\-sharing mindset that elevates team capabilities through documentation and training
* Comfortable pushing back \- on a client's assumption, an unrealistic date, or a spec that won't hold up \- and can name the model\-level reason why
* Leads by example, modeling excellent client communication, technical rigor, and operational discipline
* Collaborative working style that inspires confidence and builds trust on both sides of the engagement


Key Attributes* Client Champion: Passionate about delivering exceptional experiences and building client trust
* Curious \& Data\-Fluent: Comfortable enough with data and platforms to speak credibly to both marketers and engineers — not a coder, but not intimidated by a spreadsheet or a dashboard either
* Strategic Thinker: Sees beyond the single feed to identify patterns, systemic issues, and reusable solutions
* Sound Judgment: Knows the difference between a requirement that cannot bend and one that can, and can explain which is which to a client without hedging
* Clear Communicator: Translates technical complexity into clarity for clients and team members alike
* Ownership Mindset: Takes full accountability for delivery, quality, and the commitments made to the client. Drives work to a verified, signed\-off end state rather than a mostly\-working one
* Calm Under Pressure: Maintains composure and clarity during compressed timelines, shifting client requirements, and high\-visibility launches
* Growth\-Oriented: Proactively identifies and drives improvements to processes, documentation, and team capabilities. Receptive to feedback and committed to continuous improvement
* Leads with integrity and embraces diversity in all forms

  

**Benefits**  

* 100% Remote
* Competitive Total Rewards and flexible paid time off
* Opportunities to give back through Measured for Good
* Engaged, diverse, and curious culture
* Award\-winning technology powered by an agile, collaborative team

jobs.title: Clinical Implementation Specialist
jobs.description:
**Knowtex.ai**

**Clinical Implementation Specialist**

 **LOCATION**


Remote (US)

**TRAVEL**


20–30%, federal and commercial sites

**REPORTS TO**


Director of Customer Delivery

**LICENSE**


RN, NP, PA, PharmD, or equivalent

**SCHEDULE**


Core business hours, with flexibility across time zones

  

**About** **Knowtex.ai**
========================


Knowtex is transforming healthcare documentation through ambient AI scribe technology that allows clinicians to focus on patients instead of computers. Our platform uses advanced AI to convert natural clinical conversations into accurate, comprehensive medical documentation — reducing clinician burnout while improving care quality.


We're scaling rapidly across both the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) and a growing base of commercial health systems — two very different operating environments with one shared bar: the note has to be safe, complete, and trustworthy, every time, for every clinician who depends on it in real time.

**The Opportunity**
===================


We're at a critical inflection point. Over the next 90 days, this role will drive massive scaling across our federal and commercial portfolios.


We need a Clinical Implementation Specialist who is equal parts clinician, implementation scientist, and clinical informaticist — someone who can stand in front of a room of skeptical physicians one hour and sit inside an AI prompt the next, tracing a clinician's error report back to its root cause. You'll be the clinical voice our users trust, and the clinical judgment behind how our AI is tuned, turning what you hear on the front line into documentation that's safe, complete, and trusted by the providers who sign it.


Day to day, that means onboarding new sites and clinicians, running training, building the clinical champion network that makes adoption durable rather than a one\-time launch event, and leading recovery at sites that are struggling. You'll do this one clinician at a time and at scale, often in the same week: coaching a new user through their first generated note, and building the curriculum and playbook that carry that result everywhere else.


This role reports to the Director of Customer Delivery and works in daily partnership with the rest of Customer Delivery, and directly with Engineering (including the Technical Product Manager and on\-call engineers) to close the loop between what clinicians experience and what the product does.

**What You'll Do**
==================

**Onboarding, Training Delivery \& Coaching 30%**
-------------------------------------------------

* Conduct live virtual training sessions for clinicians across all specialties and both federal and commercial sites (physicians, NPs, PAs, pharmacists, mental health providers)
* Present at approved provider and leadership staff meetings to provide platform updates, training, and support
* Lead virtual office hours and recurring Q\&A sessions providing just\-in\-time workflow support to users at every stage, from brand\-new to long\-tenured
* Onboard and coach new users individually through early activation, adapting your approach to specialty, technical comfort, and sector (federal vs. commercial)
* Deliver train\-the\-trainer sessions to build capacity among Site POCs and Clinical Champions
* Track training attendance, completion, satisfaction, and time\-to\-activation; feed findings back into training content and coaching approach

**Training \& Educational Materials 15%**
-----------------------------------------

* Develop and maintain training curriculum, job aids, and education resources for both federal and commercial audiences, including specialty\-specific modules
* Update materials continuously based on product changes, user feedback, and clinical best practice — this is a living library, not a one\-time build
* Design self\-paced and asynchronous resources so coaching capacity scales with user volume rather than growing linearly with it
* Develop release communication for feature updates and product changes — external materials for users, and internal briefings that prepare Customer Support and Implementation before rollout

**Clinical Champion Network 10%**
---------------------------------

* Identify Clinical Champions through both adoption data and relationships built in the field, then recruit and develop them to extend adoption support within their own facilities
* Build and facilitate an active Clinical Champion community of practice — peer learning, shared best practices, and a channel that surfaces problems early
* Sustain engagement over time, not just at launch; a champion network that goes quiet within a quarter isn't doing its job

**Implementation Strategy \& Service Recovery 20%**
---------------------------------------------------

* Develop and execute implementation strategy for new and scaling sites across both sectors
* Diagnose and lead service recovery for sites in one of two distinct situations — initial adoption struggles (never really got going) and negative first\-experience recovery (tried it, had a bad early experience, and are now skeptical or vocal) — and tailor your intervention to which one you're facing
* Conduct workflow assessments to identify integration opportunities and barriers, and translate findings into a concrete site\-level plan
* Identify patterns across sites — the failure modes that repeat, the interventions that consistently work — and document them in the implementation playbook so the next site starts ahead of where the last one did

**AI Prompt Judgment \& Clinical Quality 20%**
----------------------------------------------

* Build and maintain deep product understanding — how the AI generates notes, where prompts and templates drive behavior, and where the boundaries of the model's clinical judgment are
* Interpret clinician\-reported concerns and errors (missing findings, fabricated content, incorrect clinical reasoning) and perform root cause analysis to distinguish a prompt issue from a workflow issue from a genuine model limitation
* Recommend prompt changes and carry them through implementation, grounded in clinical judgment, safety, and quality standards — with the sole aim of keeping note output safe, complete, and aligned with provider expectations
* Escalate patient safety concerns immediately per protocol; no finding sits unreviewed
* Partner on the Clinical Quality Scoring Rubric and documentation audit findings where they intersect with training or prompt behavior

**Cross\-Functional Partnership with Engineering 5%**
-----------------------------------------------------

* Work directly with the Technical Product Manager and on\-call engineers to resolve live, customer\-facing issues in real time
* Serve as the trusted clinical voice inside product and engineering discussions — translating a clinician's frustration into a specific, actionable problem statement and making the clinical case for prioritization
* Contribute to longer\-term product and feature discussions informed by frontline patterns, not just individual tickets

**Who You Are**
===============

**CLINICAL BACKGROUND**

* Active clinical license (RN, NP, PA, PharmD, or equivalent) with 5\+ years of direct patient care experience
* Understanding of clinical documentation requirements, EHR workflows, and medical decision\-making across specialties
* Comfort operating in both federal (VA) and commercial healthcare environments — or a credible plan for ramping into whichever side is less familiar
* Understanding of HIPAA, medical\-legal documentation standards, and quality requirements

**IMPLEMENTATION SCIENCE, INFORMATICS \& AI**

* Experience with implementation science frameworks (RE\-AIM, CFIR) or equivalent structured approaches to adoption and change management
* Demonstrated ability to conduct root cause analysis (5 Whys, fishbone, or equivalent) on a clinical, workflow, or quality problem
* Direct or adjacent experience with AI/NLP prompt design, prompt evaluation, or clinical documentation improvement technologies — you don't need to have built models, but you need to be comfortable reasoning about how a prompt change would or wouldn't fix a reported error
* Comfort working from product analytics and dashboards to identify patterns, not just anecdotes

**TRAINING \& EDUCATION**

* 3\+ years developing and delivering clinical education or healthcare IT training
* Demonstrated ability to build effective curriculum and measure its impact beyond satisfaction scores (retention, behavior change, time\-to\-activation)
* Experience with virtual training platforms and comfort presenting to groups from 5 to 100\+
* Track record adapting delivery across specialties and audiences with different technical proficiency

**COMMUNICATION \& JUDGMENT**

* Exceptional verbal and written communication; able to earn a skeptical clinician's trust quickly
* Strong collaborator across internal teams, with the credibility to advocate for clinical needs in technical discussions
* Comfortable delivering an executive briefing on short notice, then answering a support ticket an hour later — this role moves fluidly between strategic and hands\-on work
* Sound clinical and ethical judgment under time pressure, particularly around patient safety escalation

**MINDSET**

* Entrepreneurial, comfortable with ambiguity, and willing to pick up work that doesn't have an obvious owner
* Genuinely mission\-driven — motivated by what's at stake when the technology in question touches real\-time clinical care, not just another SaaS rollout
* Sees Engineering, Product, and the rest of Customer Delivery as partners, not separate lanes — inclined to bring people in early instead of arriving with a finished answer

**Strongly preferred**

* Master's degree in Nursing, Health Administration, Public Health, Medical Education, Clinical Informatics, or related field
* Experience with ambient AI, clinical documentation improvement, or speech recognition technologies
* Prior experience in a startup or fast\-scaling environment where role boundaries were fluid
* VA clinical experience (staff clinician, clinical educator, or clinical informaticist) and commercial health system experience
* Section 508 accessibility compliance experience

**Key Collaborations**
======================

**Technical Product Manager \& On\-Call Engineers**


Direct, frequent partnership resolving live customer issues and shaping prompt and product changes; primary channel for surfacing root\-caused clinician concerns

**Director of Customer Delivery**


Weekly 1:1s and strategic planning; escalation point for systemic clinical quality, safety, or training effectiveness issues

**Implementation \& Customer Support**


Daily coordination on training schedules, go\-lives, service recovery execution, and clinical quality issues surfaced through tickets

**Site POCs \& Clinical Champions (federal and commercial)**


Primary clinical contact for training, workflow guidance, and frontline advocacy

**Why Knowtex?**
================

**Mission that matters**


What's at stake here is different from a typical tech rollout — this technology sits inside real\-time clinical care, and getting it wrong has consequences a dashboard bug never would. Every barrier you remove is a clinician who gets time back and a patient whose documentation is safer and more complete.

**A true 0\-to\-1 environment**


We're fast\-paced, hands\-on, and every hat gets worn by everyone. No job is too small — you'll answer tickets and deliver executive briefings in the same week, and both matter.

**Direct impact, direct influence**


You'll work hands\-on with frontline clinicians and directly with the engineers who build the product you rely on. Your root\-cause findings and prompt recommendations shape what ships next.

**Team \& culture**


A tight, cross\-functional team that treats the customer's voice — and the clinician's safety — as the center of gravity for every decision.

**Logistics**
=============

**LOCATION**


Remote, with travel required to federal and commercial sites for workflow assessments, go\-lives, service recovery visits, and training events (estimated 20–30%, adjusted to implementation needs)

**REPORTS TO**


Director of Customer Delivery

**SCHEDULE**


Core business hours with flexibility for training delivery across time zones and both federal and commercial calendars

**COMPENSATION**


Competitive salary commensurate with experience, plus equity, comprehensive benefits, and professional development opportunities **.**

**To Apply**


We're looking for a clinician\-informaticist who loves teaching, thinks in root causes, and wants to shape how AI shows up safely in real clinical practice — across both federal and commercial healthcare. Please submit your resume and a cover letter addressing:

* Why a role spanning clinical practice, implementation science, and AI prompting excites you
* An example of diagnosing a clinical or workflow problem down to its root cause, and what you changed as a result
* Your approach to service recovery at a site that's either never adopted well or had a bad first experience


Knowtex.ai is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse team that reflects the clinicians and patients we serve.


Compensation Range: $110K \- $180K
